ns2:section.sectionText: 51176: Section EMP:This course will explore empathy and its everyday life implications. We will investigate psychological, sociological and biological aspects of empathy. We will use simulations to examine perspective taking and what it means in today's society. In addition, this course will look at implications for empathy related to cultural competencies. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery Course.
